whoItsFor: Developers and teams building coding agents, RAG pipelines, or LLM apps who want to cut token usage on tool outputs, logs, files, and JSON before they reach the model. The README also covers agent wrappers (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.) and an MCP server.
useCases: Reduce tokens from large tool outputs, logs, and JSON before sending them to an LLM
Route coding agents like Claude Code or Cursor through a local compression proxy with no code changes
Compress RAG chunks and conversation history inline in a Python or TypeScript app

requirements.runtime: Python (installed via pip or uv); Node.js for the npm TypeScript SDK
